name: Behind-the-Neck Lat Pulldown
steps: Sit at a cable machine pulldown station with thighs locked under the pads and take a wide overhand grip on the bar.
Sit tall with your torso upright and arms fully extended overhead.
Draw your elbows down and bring the bar behind your head only as far as you can keep your neck upright.
Extend your arms slowly back overhead under full control without letting the stack bang.
tips: Keep your neck tall and stop descending before you feel forced to poke your head forward.
Use a moderate weight and stay strictly within your comfortable shoulder mobility.
